# AI Income Systems Lab

> Practical AI business education, courses and tools for building repeatable business systems.

Monthly memberships are priced in USD: Starter $19.99, Builder $29.99, and Accelerator $44.99. Starter includes Modules 1–11 (69 lessons), Starter prompts and progress tracking. Builder includes Modules 1–12 (77 lessons), all member tools, The Lab posts, complete guides, community, templates, Product Builder and Funnel Builder. Accelerator includes all 15 modules (89 lessons), everything in Builder, Agent Generator and member direct messages.

AI Prompt Generator is free for everyone. Other tools, Lab post content and complete guides require Builder or Accelerator; they are not included with Free or Starter. Public catalogs are previews, not access to member content. Legacy Pro and administrators retain their existing access.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Platform overview and membership previews.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Current monthly prices and feature comparison.
- [Curriculum](/curriculum): Public course and module catalog; lesson access depends on membership.
- [AI Prompt Generator](/free-tools/prompt-generator): Free prompts by business type and goal.
- [Blog](/blog): Public practical AI articles.
- [Newsletter](/newsletter): Public newsletter articles.

## Optional

- [Free AI Income Launch Guide](/ai-income-launch-guide): Free PDF delivered after email signup.
- [AI Business Engine](/ai-business-engine): Free prompt guide download.
